subject: Finalize passive RDP monitor v2 workflow and menu sync
body: Finalize passive RDP monitor v2 workflow and menu sync
patch:
--- .github/workflows/passive-rdp-monitor-1772-v2.yml
@@ -1,10 +1,10 @@
-name: Build passive RDP monitor 1.77.2 files
+name: Passive RDP Monitor 1.77.2 v2
 
 on:
   workflow_dispatch:
   push:
     branches:
-      - passive-rdp-monitor-1772-files
+      - passive-rdp-monitor-1772-v2
 
 jobs:
   build:
@@ -14,17 +14,17 @@ jobs:
       - name: Checkout
         uses: actions/checkout@v4
 
-      - name: Setup .NET 6 SDK
+      - name: Setup .NET 6
         uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
         with:
           dotnet-version: '6.0.x'
 
       - name: Setup MSBuild
         uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2
 
-      - name: Restore packages
+      - name: Restore main project only
         shell: pwsh
-        run: dotnet restore .\mRemoteNG.sln
+        run: dotnet restore .\mRemoteNG\mRemoteNG.csproj
 
       - name: Build portable x64
         shell: pwsh
@@ -34,7 +34,7 @@ jobs:
         shell: pwsh
         run: |
           $source = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE "mRemoteNG\bin\x64\Release Portable"
-          $out = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE "_publish\mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-1772-win-x64"
+          $out = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE "_publish\mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-1772-v2-win-x64"
           if (!(Test-Path $source)) {
             Write-Host "Build output not found at $source"
             if (Test-Path .\mRemoteNG\bin) { Get-ChildItem -Recurse .\mRemoteNG\bin | Select-Object FullName }
@@ -47,6 +47,6 @@ jobs:
       - name: Upload portable zip
         uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
         with:
-          name: mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-1772-win-x64
-          path: _publish/mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-1772-win-x64.zip
+          name: mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-1772-v2-win-x64
+          path: _publish/mRemoteNG-passive-rdp-1772-v2-win-x64.zip
           if-no-files-found: error
--- mRemoteNG/UI/Window/ConnectionWindow.cs
@@ -505,8 +505,8 @@ private void ToggleViewOnly()
                 if (!(interfaceControl?.Protocol is ISupportsViewOnly viewOnly))
                     return;
 
-                cmenTabViewOnly.Checked = !cmenTabViewOnly.Checked;
                 viewOnly.ToggleViewOnly();
+                cmenTabViewOnly.Checked = viewOnly.ViewOnly;
             }
             catch (Exception ex)
             {
@@ -563,6 +563,11 @@ private void ToggleFullscreen()
                 var interfaceControl = GetInterfaceControl();
                 var rdp = interfaceControl?.Protocol as RdpProtocol6;
                 rdp?.ToggleFullscreen();
+                if (rdp != null)
+                {
+                    cmenTabFullscreen.Checked = rdp.Fullscreen;
+                    cmenTabViewOnly.Checked = rdp.ViewOnly;
+                }
             }
             catch (Exception ex)
             {
@@ -790,4 +795,4 @@ public void Prot_Event_Closed(object sender)
 
         #endregion
     }
-}
\ No newline at end of file
+}

security_flags.reason: CI workflow changes are the primary supply-chain vector (pull_request_target abuse, workflow injection)

triage.rationale: Menu state already refreshes from live protocol whenever opened; remaining click-time assignments are transient. The .NET 6 passive-branch workflow is obsolete.
